msg.sender becomes the initial admin, establishing the privileged caller identity.

Current pendingImplementation is snapshotted into oldPendingImplementation before overwrite.
_acceptImplementation requires msg.sender == pendingImplementation and non-zero address.

Previous implementation is snapshotted into oldImplementation before promotion.
pendingImplementation is snapshotted into oldPendingImplementation for the event log.
_setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin before staging a new admin.
Parameter newPendingAdmin is stored into pendingAdmin.

_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin and non-zero address.
pendingAdmin is promoted and written into the admin state variable.
